correctness.rationale: Arclength sampling gives independent component memberships and conditional uniform coordinates. Loop-to-attachment and within-loop distances are both uniform on [0,u/2]; cross-loop distances add the two independent radial coordinates and t; loop-to-bridge distances add a radial coordinate and a uniform bridge coordinate; the within-bridge distance has the triangular density. Weighting by length products (twice for different components) and integrating independently reproduces the two moment polynomials after s-normalization. For p=ab/s² in (0,1/4], the scaled variance derivative is [Q(r)+(1+32r−44r²)p]/[24(1+r)^4], with endpoint numerators proportional to Q(r) and (2r+1)C(r). C is strictly increasing on the positive axis; Q has exactly one positive zero by one Descartes sign change and existence from its endpoint signs. Exact rational substitutions bracket the two roots in the stated increasing order. The affine derivative is strictly negative inside the interval for r≤α, changes from negative to positive once for α<r<β, and is positive on the positive domain for r≥β. This verifies equality cases, uniqueness up to exchange, and the unattained infimum from p↓0; the positive length assumption is essential. The mean slope has sign r−1/4 and the exact witness at r=1/10 is p*=1079/4700 with improvement 384/17203175. Independent replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/nov02-independent-checks.py 5 (SymPy integration, differentiation, and exact identities). Numerical roots merely corroborate; the frozen attached script was inspected, not executed.
